text:
Rae (mkt): Need a short benchmark narrative for the launch: two visuals, one-line webinar CTA, audience infra + PMs.
Evan (data): Recommend Visual A = latency (ms) vs $/1k tokens scatter with P50/P95/P99; Visual B = routing microflow (fastpath vs econ).
Kara (design): Keep headlines <=12 words. Two clusters: quantized throughput vs unquantized quality. Use subtle SLA bands.
Sam (prod): Headline idea: 'Optimize for perceived speed; reclaim dollars elsewhere.' Webinar CTA below charts.
Evan (data): Running microbench slices: chat-short (64) and long (1024). BenchBot queued job 93456.
BenchBot: job 93456 done  csv: https://internal/bench/93456.csv
Evan (data): TL;DR numbers: chat-short P95=105ms cost=$0.11/1k; long quantized P95=305ms cost=$0.047/1k; long unquant P95=760ms cost=$0.13/1k. Quantized ~2.6x cheaper on long contexts.
Kara (design): I'll produce two PNGs + alt text: A) cluster view annotated with P95s B) split-by-workload rows + routing threshold at 150ms. Include token->dollar example labeled 'example'.
Rae (mkt): Copy for Visual A: headline 'Latency vs Unit Cost: real tradeoffs' bullets: 'P95 reflects user experience' and 'Smart routing can cut token spend 30-60% (example)'. Visual B bullets: 'Auto-route UX-critical requests' and 'Fallback to accurate model when needed'.
Sam (prod): Webinar plan: 20m demo + 10m Q&A. Title: 'Serving LLMs: tune for latency and dollars'. One-line CTA: 'See how to cut tail latency and token spend in 20 minutes.'
Evan (data): CSV and datapoints posted; happy to re-run if design wants other slices.
Rae (mkt): Final checklist: 2 PNGs + alt text, chart headlines + bullets, token example, CSV link, 1-line CTA. Target EOD. Ping if blocked. :thumbsup:
